message: Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/hdf5 && grep -rn "H5F_get_checksums" src/ | grep -v "H5Fio.c"` executed with exit code 0.

message.content:
Confirmed - the vulnerable code is present. The bug is in `H5F_get_checksums`: when `buf_size < H5_SIZEOF_CHKSUM` (4 bytes), `buf + buf_size - 4` underflows and reads 4 bytes out of bounds (heap-buffer-overflow READ 4).
